name: tributaries
goal: Demonstrate multiple roots and uneven branches before one final join.

specification.goal: Demonstrate multiple roots and uneven branches before one final join.

functional_requirements.description: The left branch ends in left-leaf evidence.
The right branch ends in right-final evidence.
The independent root completes its own evidence.

nfrs.description: The main join consumes both uneven branch results.
acceptance: joined.txt is created only after left and right final evidence exists

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('left.txt').is_file() and Path('right-final.txt').is_file(); p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'join-all\n'); Path('joined.txt').write_text(Path('left.txt').read_text() + ' + ' + Path('right-final.txt').read_text())

ready_when: the accepted left leaf and right final receipts are available
done_when: joined.txt combines the two uneven branch outcomes
contract.shared_reason: Only the main joined artifact needs both branch deliverables.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'right-final\n'); Path('right-final.txt').write_text(Path('right-middle.txt').read_text() + '-final')

ready_when: the accepted right middle artifact is available
done_when: right-final.txt contains the right final result

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'independent-leaf\n'); Path('independent.txt').write_text('independent')

done_when: independent.txt records the independent terminal result

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'left-leaf\n'); Path('left.txt').write_text(Path('left-root.txt').read_text() + '-leaf')

ready_when: the accepted left root is available
done_when: left.txt contains the left leaf result

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'right-middle\n'); Path('right-middle.txt').write_text(Path('right-root.txt').read_text() + '-middle')

ready_when: the accepted right root is available
done_when: right-middle.txt provides the right final prerequisite
contract.shared_reason: This is a reusable prerequisite layer for the one right-branch deliverable.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'left-root\n'); Path('left-root.txt').write_text('left')

done_when: left-root.txt provides the left branch prerequisite
contract.shared_reason: This root supplies only the left branch deliverable.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('schedule.log'); p.write_text((p.read_text() if p.exists() else '') + 'right-root\n'); Path('right-root.txt').write_text('right')

done_when: right-root.txt provides the right branch prerequisite
contract.shared_reason: This root supplies only the right branch deliverable.
